title: Bug: `pick_ports` function in test_voq_ipfwd.py can pick the same port for PortA and PortB
author: Javier-Tan
body:
### Is it platform specific

generic

### Importance or Severity

Medium

### Description of the bug

If we are forced to pick the same port type for 'PortA' and 'PortB' for `intfs_to_test` in `pick_ports` function, it's possible to pick the same port which is not expected.

### Steps to Reproduce

Run `pick_ports` multiple times when there is either only ethernet connections of portchannel connections to downstream neighbors, see that the function is able to choose the same port for 'PortA' and 'PortB'.

### Actual Behavior and Expected Behavior

ATM it can pick the same port, it shouldn't be able to.

### Approach
#### What is the motivation for this PR?
When using `pick_ports` function in `test_voq_ipfwd.py`, it was possible that the function chose the same port for 'portA' and 'portB' when forced to choose 2 of the same types of ports. This was causing failures in `test_voq_disrupts.py` which used the function.
#### How did you do it?
Remove 'portA' from candidates for 'portB'.
#### How did you verify/test it?
Ran the failing test a few times to make sure it no longer fails
